summary: P523 preparation rerun on the current tree: the same 42 papercusp-desktop native Node test files as the 2026-09-23 run all passed: 564 tests, 564 pass, 0 fail, 0 skipped, 0 cancelled, 0 todo, exit 0 (19 more tests than the 545 in the earlier run). assertions.evidence: The run wrote EXIT=0. The TAP output ended with tests 564, pass 564, fail 0, cancelled 0, skipped 0, todo 0, duration_ms 127214.919642. grep counted 564 'ok' lines and 0 'not ok' lines.

Before and after the run, the snapshot recorded both repo heads, the papercusp-desktop dirty count, and a SHA-256 digest of the 42 test files plus papercusp-desktop/bin/*.sh and bin/*.mjs (b53aaf93d6290cd145a27e73ec8c2997eb8331b6c605941650203032c80ad874). The digest was identical before and after. The desktop head was 0d15ef5b both times. The superproject head moved 70a7af69ae -> 44609019f1 because git-sync committed during the run. One desktop file outside the digested set, bin/vm-rig/lib/rig-profile.sh, became dirty during the run; none of the 42 test files is a vm-rig test.
192 of the 564 passing tests have refusal-shaped names (refuse, reject, FAIL, corrupt, absent, invalid, missing, denies, block). This is a name-based count, not a mutation proof.
TAP ok 363 - a reused manifest receipt re-verifies its outputs instead of publishing on trust. TAP ok 364 - a reused manifest receipt refuses outputs it did not commit.
TAP ok 48 - refuses to publish a deb when its updater signature is missing. TAP ok 49 - refuses to publish either final path when the staged signature is invalid.

TAP ok 72 - loads the conventional mode-0600 updater key when no signing env is supplied. TAP ok 73 - honors TAURI_SIGNING_PRIVATE_KEY_PATH instead of the conventional path. TAP ok 76 - signing-key preflight runs before seed staging and the expensive build.

TAP ok 68 - FAILS when db-sql/ has zero migration files. TAP ok 182 - compatibility requires extraction, intact bytes, and corruption refusal. TAP ok 188 - a passing installed update writes a tag-scoped receipt bound to provenance bytes. TAP ok 190 - Windows refuses a provenance-listed Server span when any disk is absent. TAP ok 211 - macOS refuses a GUI-only transition when the matching Server DMG is absent.

TAP ok 152 - the sidecar provenance receives the immutable build SHA and version. TAP ok 153 - vm-release sidecar reuse rejects provenance that differs from the launcher build SHA. TAP ok 245 - verify-provenance gates build-start dirt, not later cutter mutations. TAP ok 246 - verify-provenance rejects missing or non-boolean gitDirty attestations. TAP ok 247 - verify-provenance rejects missing or malformed release identity.
